fieldValues.title: B10. Where the documents differ from practice
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The handbook draws one chain from meaning to execution to governance; real work also enters directly from the owner (9e2c2950; SP-95 shipped the day it was raised) and through /rfc and steward escalations (most of October's product work was the RFC-051/052 rollout). SP-62: most real work bypasses the agreed process.
